SELECT t.id, s.k, keep FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 1), (2, 'a', 2), (3, 'b', 3)) t(id, g, n)
    JOIN (VALUES (1, 'u'), (1, 'v'), (2, 'u'), (3, 'u'), (3, 'v')) s(id, k) ON t.id = s.id DECIDE per t: keep(BOOL) SUCH THAT SUM(t: keep) >= 2 MINIMIZE MAX(t: t.n * keep)
